---
title: "What is the trimmed flight time of the 300 mm flat plate design under the library mass model?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
ENTRY_CEILING = 120.0   # s for this render, granted by the user
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0     # s for any one solve
PROBE_POOL = 200.0        # s granted for the probe
PROBE_SPENT = 61.3      # s the probe actually used

target_span = 0.300
stall_limit = 5.75
launch_h = 1.5
target_time = 2.0

sink_lib, opt_lib = optimize_geometry_library(
    get_airplane_plate, alpha_max=stall_limit, span_max=target_span
)
flight_time_lib = launch_h / sink_lib

sink_hand, opt_hand = optimize_geometry_for_sink_rate(
    get_airplane_plate, alpha_max=stall_limit, span_max=target_span
)
flight_time_hand = launch_h / sink_hand

delta_time = flight_time_lib - flight_time_hand
delta_time_pct = (delta_time / flight_time_hand) * 100
delta_mass_g = (opt_hand.m_total - opt_lib.m_total) * 1000

meets_target = flight_time_lib >= target_time
meets_target_str = "Yes" if meets_target else "No"

assert flight_time_lib < target_time
assert flight_time_lib > flight_time_hand
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"{meets_target_str}, {flight_time_lib:.2f} s"`]{.hero-value}
[trimmed flight time from 1.5 m]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** No. Under the [library mass model](2026-09-30-01-does-replacing-hand-rolled-mass-geometry-with-wing-area-and-fuselage-v.qmd), the [300 mm flat plate design](2026-09-29-06-what-is-the-minimum-trimmed-sink-rate-with-a-300-mm-flat-plate-wing.qmd) achieves a trimmed flight time of [`{python} f"{flight_time_lib:.2f} s"`]{.key} from a `{python} f"{launch_h:.1f}"` m throw, falling short of the [`{python} f"{target_time:.1f} s"`]{.key} [target](2026-09-29-02-what-is-the-trimmed-flight-time-of-the-planform-optimum.qmd). Flight time increases by [`{python} f"{delta_time:.2f} s"`]{.key} ([`{python} f"{delta_time_pct:.1f}%"`]{.key}) over the [`{python} f"{flight_time_hand:.2f} s"`]{.key} hand-rolled baseline as sink rate improves from [`{python} f"{sink_hand:.2f} m/s"`]{.key} to [`{python} f"{sink_lib:.2f} m/s"`]{.key}. This gain is driven by saving [`{python} f"{delta_mass_g:.1f} g"`]{.key} in all-up mass, which eliminates all [`{python} f"{opt_hand.mass_ballast*1000:.1f} g"`]{.key} of trim ballast (@tbl-flight-time-300mm).

```{python}
#| label: tbl-flight-time-300mm
#| tbl-cap: "Performance and mass comparison of the 300 mm flat plate wing under hand-rolled versus library models."
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

header = ["Metric", "Hand-rolled", "Library", "Delta"]
rows = [
    ("Trimmed sink rate", f"{sink_hand:.2f} m/s", f"{sink_lib:.2f} m/s", f"{(sink_lib - sink_hand)*1000:+.1f} mm/s"),
    ("Flight time (1.5 m)", f"{flight_time_hand:.2f} s", f"{flight_time_lib:.2f} s", f"{delta_time:+.2f} s"),
    ("Trim airspeed", f"{opt_hand.v_trim:.2f} m/s", f"{opt_lib.v_trim:.2f} m/s", f"{(opt_lib.v_trim - opt_hand.v_trim):+.2f} m/s"),
    ("All-up mass", f"{opt_hand.m_total*1000:.1f} g", f"{opt_lib.m_total*1000:.1f} g", f"{-delta_mass_g:+.1f} g"),
    ("Trim ballast", f"{opt_hand.mass_ballast*1000:.1f} g", f"{opt_lib.mass_ballast*1000:.1f} g", f"{(opt_lib.mass_ballast - opt_hand.mass_ballast)*1000:+.1f} g"),
]
md_table(header, rows)
```
